title: Migrate gate registry storage to a gates.toml store
description:
Replace `.jit/gates.json` with a `.jit/gates.toml` store as the sole source of truth for the gate registry, mirroring the existing validation-ruleset store's atomic-write pattern (`storage/ruleset_store.rs`).

## Background

`JsonFileStorage` currently reads/writes the gate registry as `.jit/gates.json` (`storage/json.rs:21` `GATES_FILE`, `:412-416` init scaffold, `:623-634` `load_gate_registry`/`save_gate_registry`). The registry-first item-kind engine that a later change wires `gate` into (`domain/item.rs:1086-1113` `load_toml_scope_items`) only projects an **array-of-tables** under the descriptor's `table` name — the same shape `rules.toml`/`invariants.toml` already use (`validation/rules.rs:1110-1113` `RawRulesFile { rules: Vec<RawRule> }`, `validation/invariants.rs:162-165` `RawInvariantsFile { invariants: Vec<Invariant> }`). The current `.jit/gates.json` is a JSON *object* keyed by gate key (`{"gates": {"repo-validate": {...}, ...}}`, `GateRegistry { gates: HashMap<String, Gate> }`), which is the wrong shape for that engine — this store must persist gates as a `[[gates]]` array, each entry carrying its own `key` field, and `JsonFileStorage` converts to/from its in-memory `HashMap<String, Gate>` at the boundary.

TOML has no representation for a JSON `null`: `Gate.reserved: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>` (`domain/types.rs:760-762`) can hold a `serde_json::Value::Null`, which the `toml` crate cannot serialize (unlike a top-level `Option::None` field, which the toml serializer omits transparently). This must be guarded before writing.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `.jit/gates.toml` persists the full `Gate`/`GateChecker` schema (`domain/types.rs:738-768`, `:999-1024`: version, key, title, description, stage, mode, checker with all `GateChecker::Exec` fields — command, timeout_seconds, working_dir, env, pass_context, prompt, prompt_file —, priority, reserved, auto, example_integration) as a `[[gates]]` array-of-tables (mirroring `RawRulesFile`/`RawInvariantsFile`'s `Vec<T>` wrapper pattern), not a keyed `[gates.<key>]` table. All writes go through `crate::storage::atomic_write::write_file_atomic` (temp-file + rename), matching `storage/ruleset_store.rs`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `JsonFileStorage::init`/`load_gate_registry`/`save_gate_registry` (`storage/json.rs:412-416`, `:623-634`) read and write `.jit/gates.toml` instead of `.jit/gates.json`; the `GATES_FILE` constant and module doc comment (`storage/json.rs:21`, `:48-57`) are updated to match. `jit gate create/update/list` keep working unmodified since they only depend on the `IssueStore` trait methods, never the literal filename.
- [hard] REQ-03: `Gate.reserved` is guarded against a `serde_json::Value::Null` entry when serializing to TOML (stripped or rejected before the write) — add a unit test that builds a `Gate` whose `reserved` map contains a null-valued entry and asserts the store still writes successfully.
- [hard] REQ-04: `crates/jit/tests/init_tests.rs:62` asserts `.jit/gates.toml` exists (not `.jit/gates.json`); `crates/jit/tests/gate_update_test.rs:306-310` re-reads the registry after a `gate update` as TOML — locating entries by scanning the `gates` array for the matching `key` (not indexing a JSON object by key) — and keeps asserting the same field values (the `clippy` gate's checker command/timeout and the `tests` gate's checker timeout survive the update).
- [hard] REQ-05: this repository's own `.jit/gates.json` (13 gates: code-review, npm-ci, cargo-ci, jit-validate, plan-review, tdd-reminder, cargo-ci-features, clippy, tests, fmt, repo-validate, coverage-preview, breakdown-review) is migrated field-for-field into `.jit/gates.toml` in the new array-of-tables layout, and the old `.jit/gates.json` is deleted. `jit gate list --json` reports the same 13 gates with identical fields before and after the migration.
